practices_report.description: Each test should focus on a single behavior with one Arrange-Act-Assert block.
Tests must be independent and not share mutable state; use setup/teardown when necessary.

practices_report.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_report.description: Provide tests for both happy path and error scenarios for methods under test.
Validate inputs at boundaries such as 0, -1, max values, empty strings.
Extract helpers and constants to avoid duplication and improve reuse.

practices_report.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_report.description: Keep tests short (<20 lines), simple, and without loops or complex conditionals.
Use multiple, comprehensive assertions to verify object properties or behaviors.
Avoid @Ignore/@Disabled or commented-out tests; keep tests active and maintained.
Link tests to requirements via annotations or Javadoc (REQ-, US-, JIRA-).

practices_report.practice_title: Rigorous Use of Performance and Security Tests
practices_report.description: Separate performance/security tests; use timeouts for performance checks when relevant.
Test names should be descriptive describing scenario and expected result.

practices_report.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_report.description: Avoid verbose auto-generated tests; generated tests should be minimal and intention-revealing.

practices_report.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_report.description: Tests should show design intent or BDD-style structure and cover prioritized scenarios.

practices_report.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_report.description: Tests should target public APIs and not internal implementation details or reflection.
Prefer specific assertions with descriptive messages over generic assertTrue/assertFalse.
Comments should explain 'why', not 'what'; avoid commented-out code and excessive comments.
Ensure tests are deterministic and avoid randomness/time/external dependency without mocking.

practices_report.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_report.description: Tests must not persist state or modify shared resources without cleanup.

practices_report.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_report.description: Use @Tag/@Category to classify tests for selective execution.
